Observations: The input channels match a simplified arcade grid game. Channel 2 (reward targets) has many large weights scattered across the playable 8Ã8 area, e.g. (r1,c5)=8.14, (r2,c3)=5.53, (r4,c1)=4.68, (r7,c6)=5.34, (r8,c8)=4.38, suggesting many small collectible targets rather than a few goals. Channel 1 (moving objects) has strong weights at central cells such as (r5,c5)=10.66, (r6,c5)=4.99, (r7,c5)=7.91, and nearby cells, consistent with ghosts spawning or moving through a central area. Channel 3 (obstacles) has high weights at specific interior cells forming a fixed maze, e.g. (r6,c5)=12.17, (r6,c1)=9.64, (r1,c7)=9.14, (r4,c1)=8.63, (r8,c6)=8.69. Channel 0 (agent) has high weights at many possible agent positions, e.g. (r2,c6)=13.82, (r2,c9)=9.41, (r0,c9)=9.35, (r7,c0)=8.21. The output layer has 5 actions: no-op, up, down, left, right, with biases up=1.261, down=1.065, left=0.861, right=0.855, no-op=0.931. Several hidden units strongly promote vertical movement, e.g. unit 2: up=1.003, down=1.898; unit 16: up=1.178, down=1.165; unit 19: up=1.388, down=1.367, consistent with navigating a maze.

Reasoning: The combination of one agent, multiple moving objects, many scattered reward targets, and fixed interior obstacles on a 10Ã10 border-walled grid is the signature of a simplified Pac-Man environment. Snake is ruled out because it has no separate moving objects. Frogger would have reward targets concentrated at the top, not scattered. Sokoban would have few goals and boxes that do not move autonomously. Bomberman would typically include a bomb action. The 5-action set (no-op, up, down, left, right) exactly matches Pac-Man controls, and the central moving-object weights resemble a ghost house/ghost paths.

Game: Pac-Man (specifically a simplified 10Ã10 grid version, like the PLE Pac-Man environment).

Description: The agent controls Pac-Man through a fixed maze, eating pellets (reward targets) for reward while avoiding ghosts (moving objects); collision with a ghost typically ends the episode or gives a penalty.

Confidence: 95%
